activity_statements.statement: explores for and produces crude oil and natural gas in upstream operations across multiple international geographies
refines crude oil into petroleum products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel) and markets them through Chevron and Texaco branded retail and commercial networks
produces and markets lubricants and fuel additives through its brands for automotive and industrial customers
invests in lower-carbon energy solutions and digital technologies to reduce costs and enhance safety across exploration and production operations
operates chemical manufacturing facilities producing commodity and specialty chemicals derived from petroleum feedstocks
transports oil, natural gas, and refined products through pipelines and shipping operations globally

name_reality_gap: none — Chevron is accurately understood as an integrated oil and gas company.
extraction_notes: About page provided values-focused content with limited operational specifics; segment details inferred from industry knowledge of Chevron's publicly known upstream/downstream structure. Confidence moderate for operational details not explicitly stated on the about page.
